svg.title: CASTAWAY: the island on a hi-fi front panel
svg.desc: CASTAWAY on the glowing blue-green display of an invented hi-fi receiver, the IDLETRONIC IR-600, in demo mode: a 16-segment ticker pushes in one message per bar (CASTAWAY, LO-FI ISLAND, TEN HOURS, SHE IDLES, MOSTLY, then the gags), a clock counts the 60-second theme loop, level meters follow the theme's score for drums, electric piano and kalimba and bounce for vinyl crackle and surf, and a pictogram island with one palm, where a young woman in a coral tank top and cream headphones sits nodding, lights up gag by gag.
